visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a low-angle handheld shot of a weathered multi-story apartment building on a Taiwanese street. A large, prominent cutout sign of the cartoon character Doraemon, smiling and holding a bell, is attached to the building exterior. The lighting is bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera pans across a series of yellow circular menu signs hanging under an awning. These signs list various breakfast items like bacon egg crepes and tuna egg crepes in red and blue traditional Chinese text. The background reveals a narrow urban alleyway with parked scooters. (3) The scene shifts indoors to a brightly lit, modest breakfast shop. The walls are covered with colorful menu boards and Doraemon illustrations. A man with long, wavy dark hair wearing a grey cap with a 'double u' logo sits at a yellow table, looking directly into the lens with a calm expression. (4) Close-up macro shots feature the food: a plate of golden-brown sliced egg crepes (dan bing) with bacon and a thick sandwich containing a fried chicken patty and shredded cabbage. The man is shown holding the sandwich in a plastic bag and taking a large bite while closing his eyes in enjoyment. (5) The final sequence shows a quick montage of the interior menu boards, focusing on the diversity of options like milk tea and coffee, before cutting back to the exterior Doraemon sign against the clear blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice performing an energetic, acapella rendition of the Doraemon theme song's intro melody using phonetic sounds. The delivery is rhythmic and cheerful, with clear pitch accuracy. (2) The singer transitions into the Japanese lyrics of the song, maintaining a playful and animated tone. The vocal quality is clean, with moderate volume and high emotional arousal. (3) A distinct vocalized sound effect, 'Ding!', is heard as a transition marker, followed by a rhythmic 'Bam-bam' beatbox-style pattern that anchors the song's tempo. (4) During the middle section, the singing continues but the voice becomes slightly more muffled and relaxed as the performer begins eating, yet the melodic contour of the theme song remains unmistakable. (5) The recording concludes with a long, sustained high-pitched vocal note, mimicking a cinematic finale, followed by a quick rhythmic vocal flourish to end the track.
